Package dev.itsharshxd.zentrix.api.recipe

Enum Class RecipeStation

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<RecipeStation>
dev.itsharshxd.zentrix.api.recipe.RecipeStation
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<RecipeStation>, Constable
public enum RecipeStation extends Enum<RecipeStation>
The workstation a custom recipe is made at.

The crafting table holds both shaped and shapeless recipes - ZentrixRecipe.getType() tells them apart. Every other station takes exactly one input. Cooking stations also have a cooking time, and all but the campfire award experience.

Since:
1.8.0
